title: Mother’s nightmare came true
content: I don’t know if this belongs here or not, but I want to share a couple of things to see what others think. I’ll start with my mother. As long as I can remember, my mother had awful nightmares. Her screaming would wake up everybody in the house. It was always the same dream. She would be standing in the middle of the road and an eighteen wheeler would be barreling down the road at her. She would be frozen in fear and couldn’t get out of the way of the truck. She would always wake up right before it hit her. These nightmares were a regular occurrence that happened her whole life. Many times she would jump out of bed running while still asleep. My father would grab her and wake her up. It was very frightening to us children. These dreams scared her so much that she actually had a fear of big trucks. She panicked if she had to pass one on the highway. Fast forward to the day I got the worst phone call of my life. My mother had died. She was hit head on by an eighteen wheeler. She died instantly, the other driver lived a few hours.I have never been able to get it out of my mind. Was she predicting her own death all those years? Were her dreams warning her? Now on to me. Since I was a teenager I have had reoccurring nightmares. I’m always at a carnival or fair. Sometimes it’s a huge place almost like an amusement park. Bright and airy, with lots of people. Other times it’s a dark, deserted, old fashioned carnival. Like the real old ones with the gypsy wagons, freak shows, and fortune tellers. But there is always the carnival theme. At some point in my dreams, I will always come across a baby or toddler. But it’s a demon. When this happens, suddenly people are everywhere. They chase after me and I know they are trying to kill me. No matter what I do, I can’t escape them.My screaming wakes me up right before they get me. It may not seem scary to other people, but these dreams are terrifying to me. I wake up screaming , crying, and hysterical. I’ve always had a fear of being kidnapped. I don’t understand what the carnivals symbolize or what the demon baby means. But I’ve had these nightmares regularly for 30+ years. When I think about my mother’s nightmares and how that is exactly how she died. I can’t help but wonder if my bizarre carnival nightmares, are trying to warn me of something. This is very disturbing to me. Any thoughts?
